def factor_overnight_neg_volatility(df):
    """
    Crash precursor: worst overnight return (5-day minimum) multiplied by recent
    intraday return volatility. Large negative overnight gaps combined with high
    intraday volatility signal potential regime breakdown.
    """
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(
        df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"]
    )
    min_overnight = overnight_ret.rolling(5, min_periods=5).min()
    intraday_vol = intraday_ret.rolling(20, min_periods=20).std(ddof=1)
    factor = -min_overnight * intraday_vol
    df_copy["factor_overnight_neg_volatility"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_overnight_neg_volatility"]
description: Captures crash risk through the interaction of persistent negative overnight returns (using the minimum over 5 days) and heightened intraday volatility. This combination reflects dislocation and fragility ahead of potential breakdowns.
